claimBoundary: Controlled compositions for testing how aerosol loading changes accepted Algorithm32 transport and later Color input. These are not reconstructions of named weather, climate, visibility, pollution, or historical San Jose conditions.

executable.name: Molecular only
executable.description: Rayleigh atmosphere with the Mie column removed.

executable.name: Canonical aerosol 1x
executable.description: The current canonical Algorithm32 atmosphere, unchanged.

executable.name: Canonical aerosol 2x
executable.description: The canonical Mie column doubled with spectral slope, scale height, albedo, and phase asymmetry held fixed.

executable.name: Canonical aerosol 4x
executable.description: The canonical Mie column quadrupled with spectral slope, scale height, albedo, and phase asymmetry held fixed.

declaredUnsupported.name: Ozone reference
declaredUnsupported.reason: The current atmosphere returns zero absorption; its ozone flag does not implement a density profile or wavelength-dependent cross sections.
requiredCapabilities: ozone contribution to path radiance and direct transmittance

declaredUnsupported.name: Elevated aerosol layer
declaredUnsupported.reason: The current atmosphere supports one ground-anchored exponential Mie density profile and cannot place a bounded or elevated aerosol layer.
requiredCapabilities: the same profile in scattering, extinction, and direct transmittance
